text: Alla fodii gomɗimɓe worɓe ɓen e gomɗimɓe rewɓe ɓen naadugol Ñalnde Darngal Aljannaaji ɗi canɗi ilata senngo ley kuɓeeje majji, ko ɓe duumotooɓe ndr majji poomaa, ɓe maayataa ton, ɓe sertataa e neema. O fodii ɓe kadi naadugol e kuɓeeje moƴƴuɗe ka nder Aljannaaji duumal, e yarluyee on mo Alla jippinoyta e maɓɓe on ɓurɗo ɗum fow mawnude. Ko jantaa koo, ko ɗum woni malal mawnungal, ngal eɓɓondirtaa e malal woo.
